en: Proverbs 6

p.src: 1  My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

ja: よ、もしあなたが隣人の
en: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
u.src: 1  My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

p.src: 2  you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

ja: によってわなにかかり、
en: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
u.src: 2  you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

p.src: 3  Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

ja: い出せ。 あなたは隣人の手中に入ったのだから。
en: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
u.src: 3  Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

p.src: 4  Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

ja: らせず、 まぶたをまどろませてはならない。
en: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
u.src: 4  Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

p.src: 5  Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

ja: れるかもしかのように、
en: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
u.src: 5  Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

p.src: 6  Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

ja: け。 その生き方をよく
en: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
u.src: 6  Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

p.src: 7  which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

en: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
u.src: 7  which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

p.src: 8  provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

en: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
u.src: 8  provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

p.src: 9  How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

ja: よ、いつまで眠っているのか。 いつになったら
en: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
u.src: 9  How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

p.src: 10  A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

ja: り、しばらくまどろみ、 しばらく
を組んで休んでいると、
en: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—
u.src: 10  A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

p.src: 11  so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

ja: しさが強盗のようにやって
en: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
u.src: 11  so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

p.src: 12  A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

ja: は、 ねじれた言葉を
en: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,
u.src: 12  A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

p.src: 13  who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

en: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,
u.src: 13  who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

p.src: 14  in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

ja: にはよこしまな思いがあり、
en: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
u.src: 14  in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

p.src: 15  Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

en: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
u.src: 15  Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

p.src: 16  There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

en: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
u.src: 16  There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

p.src: 17  arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

en: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
u.src: 17  arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

p.src: 18  a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

en: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
u.src: 18  a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

p.src: 19  a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

en: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
u.src: 19  a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

p.src: 20  My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

en: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
u.src: 20  My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

p.src: 21  Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

ja: び、 首に巻きつけよ。
en: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
u.src: 21  Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

p.src: 22  When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

ja: くとき、それはあなたを
き、 眠るとき、あなたを見
en: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
u.src: 22  When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

p.src: 23  For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

ja: 命令はともしびであり、 律法は
en: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
u.src: 23  For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

p.src: 24  to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

ja: から、 道を踏み外した妻の舌のへつらいから
en: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
u.src: 24  to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

p.src: 25  Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

ja: しさを欲してはならない。 そのまぶたに心を奪われてはならない。
en: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
u.src: 25  Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

p.src: 26  For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

en: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
u.src: 26  For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

p.src: 27  Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

ja: かれずにいられるだろうか。
en: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
u.src: 27  Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

p.src: 28  Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

ja: かれずにいられるだろうか。
en: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
u.src: 28  Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

p.src: 29  So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

en: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
u.src: 29  So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

p.src: 30  Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

ja: む泥棒を 軽蔑しない。
en: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,
u.src: 30  Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

p.src: 31  but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

ja: を渡さなければならない。
en: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
u.src: 31  but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

p.src: 32  He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

ja: には悟りがない。 それを
en: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
u.src: 32  He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

p.src: 33  He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

en: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
u.src: 33  He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

p.src: 34  For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

ja: りをかき立て、 夫は
en: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
u.src: 34  For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

p.src: 35  He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

ja: どのような贖いにも心を動かされず、
en: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
u.src: 35  He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
